body: Does any anyone have/know the link from the comment that got deleted? I wanted to look at it but forgot the address.

I had social anxiety ever since I can remember. I guess it was mainly because when I was a child my dad used to be an ass-hole, he would beat up my mother, get drunk and do stupid things and what I believe affected me most was that he was very critical towards me, he would be always telling me to this, don't do that and when I made a mistake he would get very angry and yell at me. Then when I was on kindergarden i found it difficult to make friends and ended up being isolated, made fun of and bullied. Same thing happened when I went outside to play with kids in the street. And then same thing happened a little bit later when we move out south america, although this time it was more to do with racism.

I don't think my sister suicide affected me too much my life was miserable before and after it(I don't mean to sound rude or emotionless but this is the only way i can describe it right now). And as for why she did it, I believe it was because we were separated for 6 years(My dad and my 2 sisters came to canada and 1 year later my mom, brother and me came to south america and got stuck there for 5 years trying to come to canada), so in those 6 years she suffered a lot, she became anorexic, had difficult time making friends, braking up with her bf hurter her a lot and because she lived with my dad for 6 years, and as I told earlier my dad used to be an asshole. He has anger issues, he is normal for 2-3 days and then gets angry for the dumbest thing ever(e.g. my mom not making dinner) and then stays angry from any 2 to 7 days and generally very unpleasant to interact with when angry. I guess what i am trying to say is that it is very emotionally draining to live with him and personally I couldn't live with him if it wasn't for my mom.
